name: Giant pitcher plant
desc: A carnivorous plant and the most notable pitcher plant of the park. Tree shrews and summit rats lick nectar from its lid and defecate into the pitcher.
about: Nepenthes rajah is a carnivorous pitcher plant species of the family Nepenthaceae. It is endemic to Mount Kinabalu and neighbouring Mount Tambuyukon in Sabah, Malaysian Borneo.
